SALISH’S 12 GAMES OF CHRISTMAS arrives on Netflix November 28.

snippet.description:

snippet.title: ASA Giganotosaurus TLC Trailer
snippet.description:
Giganotosaurus is now stepping up for its turn in the TLC spotlight!

Thanks to your Extra Life vote, the ground is beginning to shake again.

Once upon a time, the Giganotosaurus was the undisputed king of the ARKs. Few creatures could stand against it, and hearing its roar in the distance was enough to send even seasoned Survivors scrambling for safety, and taming one was a milestone few ever forgot.

Gone are the days of simply finding a safe vantage point and stocking up on tranquilizers. Getting a Giga's attention will mean proving yourself against some of the ARKs' fiercest threats. And once you've caught its eye, you'll have to survive a confrontation where pushing the beast to its limits is just as vital as knowing your own.

Those who manage to overcome that challenge will earn themselves a formidable ally with a force capable of rallying an entire tribe into battle. Just remember that there's a fine line between fighting alongside an enraged Giga and standing in its way.

Thank you again to everyone who supported Extra Life and helped bring this TLC to life.

Once upon a time, the Giganotosaurus was the undisputed king of the ARKs. Few creatures could stand against it, and hearing its roar in the distance was enough to send even seasoned Survivors scrambling for safety, and taming one was a milestone few ever forgot.

Gone are the days of simply finding a safe vantage point and stocking up on tranquilizers. Getting a Giga's attention will mean proving yourself against some of the ARKs' fiercest threats. And once you've caught its eye, you'll have to survive a confrontation where pushing the beast to its limits is just as vital as knowing your own.

Those who manage to overcome that challenge will earn themselves a formidable ally with a force capable of rallying an entire tribe into battle. Just remember that there's a fine line between fighting alongside an enraged Giga and standing in its way.

Thank you again to everyone who supported Extra Life and helped bring this TLC to life.

snippet.title: Unauthorised Absence // Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch the full short film premiere on 10th November  ⏯️ https://youtu.be/LbXqRGjnSS8

Anna, a single mother, fights to protect her nine-year-old daughter Thea, a bright child who experiences severe school-related distress and is trapped on a three-year waiting list for an autism assessment. As school scrutiny mounts, the authorities repeatedly misread Thea’s distress as defiance, subjecting both mother and daughter to escalating pressure. With fines and prosecution looming, the institutions Anna turns to for help respond not with support but with hostility and blame, reducing Thea to just another “unauthorised absence.”

Unauthorised Absence is an emotionally intimate drama about neurodivergence, school attendance fines and the human cost of an education system in crisis.

snippet.description:
GODZILLA MINUS ZERO #FilmedForIMAX
VFX, Written, and Directed by Takashi Yamazaki

Now Playing in theatres nationwide & IMAX

Follow @godzilla_toho and @GKIDSfilms for more updates!
godzillaminuszero.com

War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life.

Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant.
 
There is no third time. Everything ends here.

Shot entirely in Japan as the first-ever Japanese production to be Filmed For IMAX, GODZILLA MINUS ZERO was shot with high-definition digital cameras certified by IMAX, and optimized in sound and imagery unique to IMAX screens. The globally beloved monster returns to movie theater screens reaching greater and more terrifying heights, making GODZILLA MINUS ZERO a true cinematic event not to be missed.

snippet.title: Laxmi Mantra - 108 Times | Om Mahalaxmi Namo Namah | Lakshmi Ji Mantra | Dhanteras | Diwali Song
snippet.description:
Awaken to a morning blessed with infinite wealth, divine abundance, and pure happiness with the sacred continuous chanting of "Laxmi Mantra - 108 Times" (Om Mahalaxmi Namo Namah). Listening to or meditating upon this powerful morning prayer dispels financial distress, removes negative blockages, and fills your surroundings with peace, prosperity, and positive energy.

"Om Mahalaxmi Namo Namah, Om Vishnupriyaye Namo Namah, Om Dhanpradaye Namo Namah, Om Vishwasannane Namo Namah" is a deeply auspicious Vedic invocation dedicated to Goddess Lakshmi, the consort of Lord Vishnu and the cosmic provider of wealth, well-being, and harmony. Chanting this divine mantra for 108 cycles aligns your personal vibrations with cosmic abundance. It pays homage to Maa Lakshmi not only as the giver of gold and money (Dhana), but also as the source of health, peace of mind, family concord, and spiritual illumination.

Immerse yourself in this soulful Laxmi Song with pure faith to build an impenetrable spiritual shield around your finances, career, and household. The rhythmic sound vibrations soothe an anxious mind, dissolve emotional fatigue, and cultivate sharp focus, optimism, and heartfelt gratitude. For anyone aiming for career growth, business expansion, or general household prosperity, surrendering to the divine lotus feet of Goddess Lakshmi brings total success and protection.

The ideal time to listen to this peaceful Diwali Song and mantra meditation is early morning during Brahma Muhurta, or during evening Sandhya prayers, especially on Fridays and throughout the Diwali festival season. Let the divine resonance guide you into uninterrupted meditation and joy.

Om Mahalaxmi Namo Namah! Shubh Deepawali!

What is Roblox? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where kids of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community.  Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

snippet.title: 🌴 DJ PARTY 71 – WILD HEART CALLING | Exotic Tropical House / Tribal Beats / Latin Vibes
snippet.description:
“WILD HEART CALLING” combines a deep tropical groove with Latin Urban rhythm, tribal percussion, Melodic Techno atmosphere and powerful Slap House bass.

At 100 BPM, the track moves with a slower, heavier and more hypnotic pulse. Tribal drums, congas, bongos, shakers and syncopated Latin percussion create an exotic rhythm, while the wooden flute hook, atmospheric synths and catchy vocal chant give the song its own distinctive identity.

Male rhythmic verses meet a powerful female chorus, building into tribal breaks, melodic transitions and a deep final drop.

🎧 Artist: DJ PARTY 71
🎵 Title: WILD HEART CALLING
⚡ BPM: 100
🎶 Style: Tropical House / Latin Urban / Tribal House / Melodic Techno House / Slap House / Eurodance / Hip House

Turn it up, follow the rhythm and let the wild heart take control.

#djparty71 #tropicalhouse #latinurban #tribalhouse #slaphouse #melodictechno #eurodance #hiphouse #dancemusic #electronicmusic #tophits2026 #newdancevideos

snippet.title: P1Harmony (피원하모니) - ‘BLOW UP’ MV
snippet.description:
P1Harmony (피원하모니) - ‘BLOW UP’ MV

[Apple Music] : https://music.apple.com/us/album/blow-up/6827384345
[Melon] : https://kko.to/-jVhIAE0TC
[Spotify] : https://open.spotify.com/intl-ko/album/3O78x7QhCrZfS21Qp4njPS

미니 10집 ‘BLOW UP’은 영웅으로 복귀한 피원하모니가 마지막 임무를 수행하며, 오랜 시간 이어온 HERO로서의 여정을 완성하는 이야기를 담는다. 데뷔 초부터 끝없이 확장해 온 영웅 서사를 자신들만의 방식으로 그려 낸다. 

피원하모니가 그리는 영웅은 마지막까지도 유쾌하다. 이들은 세상을 구해야 한다는 거대한 사명 속에서도 때로는 엉뚱하고, 때로는 인간적인 모습을 보여 주며 기존의 영웅 서사와는 다른 시선으로 영웅의 이야기를 확장해왔다. 이번 앨범에서도 마지막 임무를 수행하는 피원하모니의 모습을 유쾌하게 그려내며 피원하모니만의 영웅 서사를 완성한다. 

타이틀곡 ‘BLOW UP’은 PC Music의 독창적인 사운드 미학을 감각적으로 풀어낸 하이퍼팝 장르의 곡이다. 글리치한 신시사이저와 하이퍼 드럼이 만들어내는 폭발적인 사운드는 경험한 적 없는 신선한 해방감을 선사한다. 한계를 깨고 나아가며 함께 성장해 온 짜릿한 여정을 담아낸 이 곡은 자신만의 길을 걸어온 피원하모니의 독보적인 존재감을 각인시키며, 거침없이 이어져 온 그들의 행보에 더욱 강력한 추진력을 더한다.

‘BLOW UP’의 퍼포먼스는 음악의 리듬과 분위기를 움직임으로 표현하는 데 초점을 맞췄다. 곡의 흐름에 따라 동작의 속도와 강약에 변화를 주며 음악의 에너지를 살리는 방향으로 구성했다. 특히 도입부에서는 비트와 리듬을 세밀하게 표현하는 움직임으로 곡의 그루브를 자연스럽게 녹였고, 후렴구에서는 마치 하늘 위를 달리며 질주하는 듯한 안무로 곡의 속도감을 직관적으로 표현했다. 여기에 멤버들의 개성과 표현력을 살린 움직임이 더해져 그룹 특유의 자유로운 에너지를 보여주며, 피원하모니만의 역동적인 퍼포먼스를 완성한다.

이번 앨범 역시 피원하모니 멤버들의 음악적 고민과 색깔이 고스란히 녹아들었다. 인탁과 종섭은 타이틀곡을 포함한 전곡 작사에 참여했으며, 기호 역시 ‘element’의 작사와 ‘MOMENTUM’의 작사·작곡에 이름을 올렸다. 멤버들의 적극적인 음악 참여를 통해 피원하모니만의 색깔과 이야기를 더욱 선명하게 담아냈다. 

한계를 정해두지 않는 것. 그것이 피원하모니가 새로운 이야기와 새로운 음악을 만들어가는 방식이다. 영웅으로서의 마지막 임무를 마친 피원하모니는 이제 궤도를 벗어나 더 넓은 곳으로 나아간다. ‘BLOW UP’은 오랜 영웅 서사를 완성하는 동시에 한계를 넘어 더 높이, 더 멀리 뻗어가는 피원하모니의 새로운 챕터를 더욱 기대하게 하는 앨범이다. 

“BLOW UP,” P1Harmony’s tenth mini album, embodies the story of P1Harmony completing their long-time journey as a group of heroes, returning and carrying out their final mission. It portrays their narrative as a group of heroes, in their own style, which has been expanding endlessly since their debut.

The heroes portrayed by P1Harmony are cheerful until the end. They have been showing their quirky and humane sides, while carrying out their duty of saving the world and expanding their story as heroes, which sets them apart from different hero stories. This album portrays P1Harmony carrying out their final mission cheerfully, completing P1Harmony’s story as a group of heroes. 

“BLOW UP,” the title track, is a song of hyper pop genre that unfolds the original sound aesthetics of PC music. Explosive sound created by the glitchy synthesizer and hyper drums present a new feeling of freedom which has never been experienced. This song, embodying the thrilling journey of breaking through the limits, moving forward, and growing together, imprints P1Harmony’s unmatched journey, and gives momentum to the members’ unstoppable drive forward.

The performance for “BLOW UP” focuses on expressing the rhythm and vibe of the music through movements. It emphasizes the music’s energy by changing the speed and accent of the movements according to the flow of the song. In particular, the opening naturally blends the groove of the song with movements delicately portraying the beats and the rhythm, and the chorus directly expresses the speed of the song with choreography that makes the members appear as if they are racing across the sky. Additional movements that emphasize the members’ characteristics and expressions show the group’s unique free energy, and complete P1Harmony’s dynamic performance.

This album is also a blend of P1Harmony’s deep reflections and styles of music. INTAK and JONGSEOB participated in writing the lyrics for all the tracks, including the title track. 미니 10집 ‘BLOW UP’은 영웅으로 복귀한 피원하모니가 마지막 임무를 수행하며, 오랜 시간 이어온 HERO로서의 여정을 완성하는 이야기를 담는다. 데뷔 초부터 끝없이 확장해 온 영웅 서사를 자신들만의 방식으로 그려 낸다. 

피원하모니가 그리는 영웅은 마지막까지도 유쾌하다. 이들은 세상을 구해야 한다는 거대한 사명 속에서도 때로는 엉뚱하고, 때로는 인간적인 모습을 보여 주며 기존의 영웅 서사와는 다른 시선으로 영웅의 이야기를 확장해왔다. 이번 앨범에서도 마지막 임무를 수행하는 피원하모니의 모습을 유쾌하게 그려내며 피원하모니만의 영웅 서사를 완성한다. 

타이틀곡 ‘BLOW UP’은 PC Music의 독창적인 사운드 미학을 감각적으로 풀어낸 하이퍼팝 장르의 곡이다. 글리치한 신시사이저와 하이퍼 드럼이 만들어내는 폭발적인 사운드는 경험한 적 없는 신선한 해방감을 선사한다. 한계를 깨고 나아가며 함께 성장해 온 짜릿한 여정을 담아낸 이 곡은 자신만의 길을 걸어온 피원하모니의 독보적인 존재감을 각인시키며, 거침없이 이어져 온 그들의 행보에 더욱 강력한 추진력을 더한다.

‘BLOW UP’의 퍼포먼스는 음악의 리듬과 분위기를 움직임으로 표현하는 데 초점을 맞췄다. 곡의 흐름에 따라 동작의 속도와 강약에 변화를 주며 음악의 에너지를 살리는 방향으로 구성했다. 특히 도입부에서는 비트와 리듬을 세밀하게 표현하는 움직임으로 곡의 그루브를 자연스럽게 녹였고, 후렴구에서는 마치 하늘 위를 달리며 질주하는 듯한 안무로 곡의 속도감을 직관적으로 표현했다. 여기에 멤버들의 개성과 표현력을 살린 움직임이 더해져 그룹 특유의 자유로운 에너지를 보여주며, 피원하모니만의 역동적인 퍼포먼스를 완성한다.

이번 앨범 역시 피원하모니 멤버들의 음악적 고민과 색깔이 고스란히 녹아들었다. 인탁과 종섭은 타이틀곡을 포함한 전곡 작사에 참여했으며, 기호 역시 ‘element’의 작사와 ‘MOMENTUM’의 작사·작곡에 이름을 올렸다. 멤버들의 적극적인 음악 참여를 통해 피원하모니만의 색깔과 이야기를 더욱 선명하게 담아냈다. 

한계를 정해두지 않는 것. 그것이 피원하모니가 새로운 이야기와 새로운 음악을 만들어가는 방식이다. 영웅으로서의 마지막 임무를 마친 피원하모니는 이제 궤도를 벗어나 더 넓은 곳으로 나아간다. ‘BLOW UP’은 오랜 영웅 서사를 완성하는 동시에 한계를 넘어 더 높이, 더 멀리 뻗어가는 피원하모니의 새로운 챕터를 더욱 기대하게 하는 앨범이다. 

“BLOW UP,” P1Harmony’s tenth mini album, embodies the story of P1Harmony completing their long-time journey as a group of heroes, returning and carrying out their final mission. It portrays their narrative as a group of heroes, in their own style, which has been expanding endlessly since their debut.

The heroes portrayed by P1Harmony are cheerful until the end. They have been showing their quirky and humane sides, while carrying out their duty of saving the world and expanding their story as heroes, which sets them apart from different hero stories. This album portrays P1Harmony carrying out their final mission cheerfully, completing P1Harmony’s story as a group of heroes. 

“BLOW UP,” the title track, is a song of hyper pop genre that unfolds the original sound aesthetics of PC music. Explosive sound created by the glitchy synthesizer and hyper drums present a new feeling of freedom which has never been experienced. This song, embodying the thrilling journey of breaking through the limits, moving forward, and growing together, imprints P1Harmony’s unmatched journey, and gives momentum to the members’ unstoppable drive forward.

The performance for “BLOW UP” focuses on expressing the rhythm and vibe of the music through movements. It emphasizes the music’s energy by changing the speed and accent of the movements according to the flow of the song. In particular, the opening naturally blends the groove of the song with movements delicately portraying the beats and the rhythm, and the chorus directly expresses the speed of the song with choreography that makes the members appear as if they are racing across the sky. Additional movements that emphasize the members’ characteristics and expressions show the group’s unique free energy, and complete P1Harmony’s dynamic performance.

This album is also a blend of P1Harmony’s deep reflections and styles of music. INTAK and JONGSEOB participated in writing the lyrics for all the tracks, including the title track. KEEHO is also credited as a lyricist for “element” and a lyricist and composer for  “MOMENTUM.” Through the members’ passionate participation, P1Harmony’s style and stories are embodied more vividly.

Not setting limits. That’s how P1Harmony creates new stories and new music. After finishing their final mission as a group of heroes, P1Harmony now leaves orbit and heads to a greater world beyond. “BLOW UP” completes P1Harmony’s long narrative as a group of heroes and signals the beginning of a new chapter as they push beyond their limits and reach higher.

Berserkers were fearsome Norse warriors famed for their ferocity in battle. His death allowed the English to advance and ultimately defeat Harald Hardrada’s army, in a battle often seen as marking the end of the Viking Age in England.

He’s fighting, halls of Valhalla waiting, never surrender
Slay them, facing the charge alone

Blood they will bring, form a shield wall to face them
Death of a king, make a stand for revenge
Heeding the call, as the fallen in battle remain
Enter the hall, to the home of the slain

On that day in September 
As the end of an era draws near
Will the future remember
How it ended, a Berserker pierced by a spear

========= Historic Fact ==========

Berserkers were fearsome Norse warriors famed for their ferocity in battle. Old Norse accounts link them to Odin and describe them entering a frenzied state known as berserksgangr, fighting with extraordinary fury. Legend has it that during the Battle of Stamford Bridge in 1066, a lone Viking warrior held the bridge against the English army and killed numerous soldiers before being struck from below by a spear. His death allowed the English to advance and ultimately defeat Harald Hardrada’s army, in a battle often seen as marking the end of the Viking Age in England.

snippet.title: WARDOGS | Road to Season 03
snippet.description:
Leave your WARDOGS Feedback here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1867240/WARDOGS

WARDOGS Season 03 drops November 12th.

In today’s DEVLOG, we recap where we went wrong with Season 02 and lay out what Season 03 is built upon. No social experiments. No reactivity. A brand new map, longer seasons, and a commitment to building the best version of WARDOGS on the road to 1.0.

Also announced: The new map, Sabatulo, brings urban warfare and close-quarters combat to WARDOGS.
We also address cheating, exploiting, and what we’re doing about it going into Season 03.

More information is dropping in the WARDOGS Season 03 Patch Notes Preview early next week.

snippet.title: How To BREAK Graveyard Keeper 2
snippet.description:
Welcome one and all to Graveyard keeper 2 a fantastic sequel to the iconic graveyard keeper game that is not only one of my favourites but also beloved by thousands if not millions of people. Today I the spiffing brit have embarked on a quest to see if the game is a perfectly balanced simulator game with no exploits or if perhaps there are some bugs, glitches and unintended features that we can use to break the game!

Want a good drink? Checkout Holy here http://uk.holy.com/brit

I recorded all of this in the first few days of the games release and I would personally like to thank @FloydsonYT for their early 100% video as it was super useful in working out how to quickly progress through the game letting me find exploits faster. 


Chapters:
00:00:00 - Intro
00:01:52 - Making Progress In Game
00:05:35 - A Spot Of Tea
00:07:18 - The Problem Of Energy
00:13:51 - Return Of The FPS (Goodbye Infinite Zombies)
00:19:30 - Retaking the Town
00:16:47- How To Duplicate Everything
00:24:40- Graveyard Keeper 2 Is Broken.

Wade is a poor janitor struggling to pay for his sick little sister's medical treatments when he witnesses a trillionaire's helicopter crash into the ocean. snippet.title: You Are NOT Ready For GTA 6!
snippet.description:
GTA 5 sold over 230 million copies and we’ve been waiting over 13 years for the next game in the series. Finally it’s arriving on November 19th so I thought now would be a great time to see what has changed from our time in Los Santos. I’ve gone through years of trailers, interviews and all the official titbits Rockstar has shown us to find the biggest changes and overhauls confirmed in GTA 6! Here’s 15 new features and evolved mechanics in GTA6! 

#gta6 #gtaiv #gta5 #jason #lucia #gta6ps5 #GrandTheftAutoVI

00:00 - Intro
00:25 - Body Dynamics
01:42 - Romance
03:03 - Robberies Evolved
04:30 - Heat System
05:54 - Wanted
08:10 - Criminal Profile
09:20 - Bullet Time / Dead Eye / Focus
10:00 - Money
11:11 - Fences / Middle Man
12:09 - NPCs Evolved
13:36 - Dynamic Weather

snippet.title: “Special Forces” Find Out Why Antartica Is off Limits to Everyone!
snippet.description:
Welcome to UNFROST demo gameplay! An Antarctic horror FPS about hunting ancient entities known as the Riftborne. Gather evidence, survive extreme conditions, prepare a nuclear strike, and extract before impact. Playing with @Fisk 

Follow Me Here:
➜ http://instagram.com/thefoosterchannel 
➜ Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/thafooster

ABOUT UNFROST:
UNFROST is an online co-op survival horror game set in Antarctica, where you hunt ancient entities known as the Riftborne. Gather evidence, survive extreme conditions, and prepare the only weapon capable of killing them: a correctly configured nuclear strike.
Coordinate under pressure. Split tasks, mark locations, transport equipment, share evidence, and regroup before the mission falls apart. One player may investigate anomalies while another secures the perimeter or hauls critical equipment through a blizzard. Every decision matters.
Antarctica is your first enemy. Endure freezing temperatures, blizzards, and unforgiving conditions while managing warmth, supplies, and sanity. The longer your expedition lasts, the greater the pressure becomes.
The Riftborne isn't waiting at the end of the mission - it is hunting you from the beginning. It reacts to your actions, reshapes the battlefield, destroys parts of the environment, and forces your squad to constantly adapt.
Once your squad understands the Riftborne's weakness, the final phase begins. Configure the correct nuclear payload, launch the strike, and extract before impact. There are no second chances.

Game Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3377450/UNFROST/

snippet.title: Firearms Expert Reacts to Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Multiplayer Guns | EXP
snippet.description:
Jonathan Ferguson, an expert in firearms history, and the Keeper of Firearms & Artillery at the Royal Armouries Museum in the UK, reacts to the the weapons and attachments of the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 multiplayer, including the modernised Mosin-Nagant, the oddly wonky Hyeon Burst, and the 3D printed fun of the single use Zip Gun. 

00:00 - Intro
01:01 - ISO Nightshade
04:25 - Mosin-Nagant
06:52 - Warlord
10:31 - Axion
14:04 - Why not check out our Patreon?
14:31 - Hyeon Burst 
17:14 - Kastov 762
20:40 - Cronen Squall
23:32 - KG-7 Vulcan
26:21 - Wz .55 Striga
29:59 - Zip Gun

In this episode of Expert Reacts on EXP, Jonathan Ferguson--an expert in firearms history and the Keeper of Firearms & Artillery at the Royal Armouries Museum in the UK--breaks down more of the guns of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, and compares them to their real-life counterparts with artefacts from the Royal Armouries archive.

If you're interested in seeing more of Jonathan's work, you can check out more from the Royal Armouries right here. - https://www.youtube.com/user/RoyalArmouries  

If you would like to support the Royal Armouries, you can make a charitable donation to the museum here. - https://royalarmouries.org/support-us/donate

And if you would like to become a member of the Royal Armouries, you can get a membership here. - https://royalarmouries.org/support-us/become-a-member

You can purchase Jonathan's book here. - https://www.headstamppublishing.com/bullpup-rifle-book

You can subscribe to the Armax Journal that Jonathan Associate Edited here: https://www.armaxjournal.org/
